title: DONDA 2 [Promo]
description: This promotional art for DONDA 2 was used for the announcement of the record and its release date of February 22, 2022. The artwork was posted on Kanye West's Instagram on January 27, 2022. The image shows Kanye's Chicago South Shore childhood home burning down in a billboard. In the third and final listening party for his previous album, Donda, at the Soldier Field stadium, Ye recreated the aforementioned house as the stage of the event. Near the end of the show, he set himself on fire inside it.
